info.sub_ename: LEADING TO SELF DISCOVERY BY PICTURE BOOKS

description.sub_ename: LEADING TO SELF DISCOVERY BY PICTURE BOOKS
description.describe_ch: 繪本具備言簡意賅和圖像化的傳達模式，作為自我覺察的媒介，正好提供給學生一個更自由的反思空間，不同人生時期閱讀同一繪本，會產生不同的覺察觀照活動。本課程透過經典寓言繪本之引導，設計課室中進行的人本取向活動(Humanistic Techniques)，從繪本主角反觀自我而啟動自我覺察之旅。課程內容著重於反思我我關係、人我關係、物我關係、天我關係等四大生命面向，以期提升自我之感性、意志、態度、價值、人生觀等生命素養。
description.describe_eh: The use of picture books as a tool for self-awareness is primarily because their succinct and expressive visual communication mode provides students with a more open space for reflection. Coupled with the accumulated life experiences of university students, the level of inspiration from the same picture book is bound to be higher than during childhood. This course, guided by classic fable picture books and supplemented with humanistic techniques, prompts students to reflect on themselves through the characters of the picture books, initiating a journey of self-awareness. The focus of the course lies in reflecting on the self in relation to others, interpersonal relationships, object-subject relationships, and the relationship with the natural world—addressing these four major dimensions of life. The aim is to enhance personal sensibility, willpower, attitudes, values, and life perspectives, fostering a holistic development of life skills.

targets.describe_en: 1. Reflecting on the relationship between oneself and others
2. Enhancing appreciation and care for life

Therefore, remember to see the instructor during the class break to change your attendance status for the second period of class. 請準時上課。點名時一次點兩節課，點名後才進教室者，該節將以曠課論，並請同學於課間自行找教師補點名，以銷掉第二節課之曠課記錄。 2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。 3. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。上課請攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。 4. Please be punctual in submitting and uploading your assignments. Late or replacement assignments will not be accepted (leave-takers are advised to pay attention to the due date of their assignments). 繳交、上傳作業請務必準時， 一律不接受遲交或補交作業 (請假者請自行注意作業繳交日期)。 5. For make-up exams and tests, all points will be deducted from 80 points. Applications for making up classroom activities or exams should be made within one week of the original time and will not be accepted after that time. The maximum number of make-ups for classroom exercises/tests is 3 per semester, and only those who are on systematic leave of absence are allowed to apply for make-ups. 補考或補做課堂練習和測驗，分數一律從80分起扣。申請補做或補考課堂活動、考試請於原時間之一個禮拜內申請，逾時不接受申請。 申請課堂練習/測驗補做或補考之規定：一學期最多可申請3次，有於系統請假者才可以申請，遲到、曠課一律不接受申請。 6. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration. 學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。 7. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。 8. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
